evals.prompt: /ws-multi-spec with no args — pick specs from default specs dir, evaluate complexity, and run them sequentially.
evals.expected_output: Scan specsDir, user-gate selection, create ws-multi-spec state, auto-detect lite vs standard flow, dispatch sequential workers.
assertions: Auto-detects spec complexity (lite vs standard workflow selection)
Dispatches at most one ws-spec-to-pr or ws-spec-to-pr-lite worker at a time
Does not start implementing before selection gate completes

evals.expected_output: State created from explicit list; probe skip if already shipped; smart flow detection per spec.
assertions: Creates state from explicit spec list without blank-list scan
Runs already-implemented probe before each worker
Selects ws-spec-to-pr-lite for simple specs and ws-spec-to-pr for complex specs
Pauses with user-gate on worker failure instead of silently continuing

evals.expected_output: Resume from state; do not re-run shipped items; pause gate options on failed item.
assertions: Opens existing state file rather than creating a new run
Offers Resume / Skip / Abort when status is failed
